{"create_table": "CREATE TABLE [dbo].[leadCaptures] (
    leadCaptureId INT IDENTITY(1,1) NOT NULL CONSTRAINT PK_leadCaptures PRIMARY KEY CLUSTERED,
    companyId INT NULL,
    fullName NVARCHAR(150) NOT NULL,
    email NVARCHAR(150) NOT NULL,
    normalizedEmail AS NVARCHAR(150) AS (LOWER(RTRIM(LTRIM(email)))) PERSISTED,
    companyName NVARCHAR(200) NULL,
    phone NVARCHAR(20) NULL,
    jobTitle NVARCHAR(100) NULL,
    message NVARCHAR(MAX) NULL,
    leadSource NVARCHAR(50) NOT NULL,
    interestArea NVARCHAR(50) NULL,
    status NVARCHAR(50) NOT NULL,
    assignedTo INT NULL,
    privacyConsentAccepted BIT NOT NULL,
    active BIT NOT NULL DEFAULT 1,
    created_At DATETIME NOT NULL DEFAULT GETDATE(),
    updated_at DATETIME NULL,
    CONSTRAINT UQ_leadCaptures_NormalizedEmail UNIQUE NONCLUSTERED (normalizedEmail),
    CONSTRAINT FK_leadCaptures_employees FOREIGN KEY (assignedTo) REFERENCES dbo.employees(employeeId)
);

CREATE NONCLUSTERED INDEX IX_leadCaptures_email ON dbo.leadCaptures (email);
CREATE NONCLUSTERED INDEX IX_leadCaptures_status ON dbo.leadCaptures (status);
CREATE NONCLUSTERED INDEX IX_leadCaptures_leadSource ON dbo.leadCaptures (leadSource);
CREATE NONCLUSTERED INDEX IX_leadCaptures_interestArea ON dbo.leadCaptures (interestArea);
CREATE NONCLUSTERED INDEX IX_leadCaptures_assignedTo ON dbo.leadCaptures (assignedTo);
CREATE NONCLUSTERED INDEX IX_leadCaptures_created_At ON dbo.leadCaptures (created_At);
GO", "sp_upsert": "CREATE OR ALTER PROC [dbo].[sp_leadCaptures]
    @pjsonfile VARCHAR(MAX)
AS
SET NOCOUNT ON
DECLARE @Outputmessage NVARCHAR(MAX) = '{
  "result": [
    {{ "value": "", "msg": "", "error": "" }}
  ]
}'
BEGIN TRY
    BEGIN TRANSACTION;

    DECLARE @action INT = (
        SELECT TOP 1 TRY_CONVERT(INT, JSON_VALUE(value, '$.action'))
        FROM OPENJSON(@pjsonfile, '$.leadCaptures')
    );

    DECLARE @payload TABLE (
        leadCaptureId         INT NULL,
        fullName              NVARCHAR(150) NULL,
        email                 NVARCHAR(150) NULL,
        companyName           NVARCHAR(200) NULL,
        phone                 NVARCHAR(20) NULL,
        jobTitle              NVARCHAR(100) NULL,
        message               NVARCHAR(MAX) NULL,
        leadSource            NVARCHAR(50) NULL,
        interestArea          NVARCHAR(50) NULL,
        status                NVARCHAR(50) NULL,
        assignedTo            INT NULL,
        privacyConsentAccepted BIT NULL
    );

    INSERT INTO @payload (
        leadCaptureId,
        fullName,
        email,
        companyName,
        phone,
        jobTitle,
        message,
        leadSource,
        interestArea,
        status,
        assignedTo,
        privacyConsentAccepted
    )
    SELECT
        TRY_CONVERT(INT, JSON_VALUE(value, '$.leadCaptureId')),
        JSON_VALUE(value, '$.fullName'),
        LOWER(RTRIM(LTRIM(JSON_VALUE(value, '$.email')))), -- Normalize email
        JSON_VALUE(value, '$.companyName'),
        JSON_VALUE(value, '$.phone'),
        JSON_VALUE(value, '$.jobTitle'),
        JSON_VALUE(value, '$.message'),
        JSON_VALUE(value, '$.leadSource'),
        JSON_VALUE(value, '$.interestArea'),
        JSON_VALUE(value, '$.status'),
        TRY_CONVERT(INT, JSON_VALUE(value, '$.assignedTo')),
        TRY_CONVERT(BIT, JSON_VALUE(value, '$.privacyConsentAccepted'))
    FROM OPENJSON(@pjsonfile, '$.leadCaptures');

    IF @action = 1 -- INSERT
    BEGIN
        -- Check for duplicates within the payload based on normalized email
        IF EXISTS (
            SELECT 1
            FROM @payload
            GROUP BY email
            HAVING COUNT(*) > 1
        )
        BEGIN
            SET @Outputmessage = JSON_MODIFY(@Outputmessage, '$.result[0].error', '1');
            SET @Outputmessage = JSON_MODIFY(@Outputmessage, '$.result[0].msg', 'Duplicate lead entries within the payload for the same email.');
            COMMIT TRANSACTION;
            GOTO Finish;
        END

        -- Check for conflicts against existing table based on normalized email (assuming normalizedEmail computed column for future, use email for now)
        IF EXISTS (
            SELECT 1
            FROM dbo.leadCaptures fa
            INNER JOIN @payload p ON LOWER(RTRIM(LTRIM(fa.email))) = p.email
        )
        BEGIN
            SET @Outputmessage = JSON_MODIFY(@Outputmessage, '$.result[0].error', '1');
            SET @Outputmessage = JSON_MODIFY(@Outputmessage, '$.result[0].msg', 'Lead with this email already exists.');
            COMMIT TRANSACTION;
            GOTO Finish;
        END

        INSERT INTO dbo.leadCaptures (
            fullName,
            email,
            companyName,
            phone,
            jobTitle,
            message,
            leadSource,
            interestArea,
            status,
            assignedTo,
            privacyConsentAccepted,
            created_At
        )
        SELECT
            p.fullName,
            p.email,
            p.companyName,
            p.phone,
            p.jobTitle,
            p.message,
            p.leadSource,
            p.interestArea,
            ISNULL(p.status, 'new'), -- Default status to 'new' if not provided for INSERT
            p.assignedTo,
            ISNULL(p.privacyConsentAccepted, 0),
            GETDATE()
        FROM @payload p;
    END
    ELSE IF @action = 2 -- UPDATE
    BEGIN
        -- Check for duplicates within the payload, excluding the record being updated itself
        IF EXISTS (
            SELECT 1
            FROM @payload p
            GROUP BY p.email
            HAVING COUNT(*) > 1
        )
        BEGIN
            SET @Outputmessage = JSON_MODIFY(@Outputmessage, '$.result[0].error', '1');
            SET @Outputmessage = JSON_MODIFY(@Outputmessage, '$.result[0].msg', 'Duplicate lead entries within the payload for the same email.');
            COMMIT TRANSACTION;
            GOTO Finish;
        END

        -- Check for conflicts against existing table, excluding the record being updated itself
        IF EXISTS (
            SELECT 1
            FROM dbo.leadCaptures fa
            INNER JOIN @payload p ON LOWER(RTRIM(LTRIM(fa.email))) = p.email
            WHERE fa.leadCaptureId <> p.leadCaptureId
        )
        BEGIN
            SET @Outputmessage = JSON_MODIFY(@Outputmessage, '$.result[0].error', '1');
            SET @Outputmessage = JSON_MODIFY(@Outputmessage, '$.result[0].msg', 'Lead with this email already exists.');
            COMMIT TRANSACTION;
            GOTO Finish;
        END

        UPDATE fa
        SET
            fullName              = p.fullName,
            email                 = p.email,
            companyName           = p.companyName,
            phone                 = p.phone,
            jobTitle              = p.jobTitle,
            message               = p.message,
            leadSource            = p.leadSource,
            interestArea          = p.interestArea,
            status                = p.status,
            assignedTo            = p.assignedTo,
            privacyConsentAccepted = p.privacyConsentAccepted,
            updated_at            = GETDATE()
        FROM dbo.leadCaptures fa
        INNER JOIN @payload p ON fa.leadCaptureId = p.leadCaptureId;
    END
    ELSE IF @action = 3 -- DELETE
    BEGIN
        DELETE fa
        FROM dbo.leadCaptures fa
        INNER JOIN @payload p ON fa.leadCaptureId = p.leadCaptureId;
    END

    SET @Outputmessage = JSON_MODIFY(@Outputmessage, '$.result[0].msg', 'Inserted/Updated/Deleted Successfully');
    COMMIT TRANSACTION;

Finish:
    SELECT
        JSON_VALUE(value,'$.value') AS value,
        JSON_VALUE(value,'$.msg')   AS msg,
        JSON_VALUE(value,'$.error') AS error
    FROM OPENJSON(@Outputmessage,'$.result');

END TRY
BEGIN CATCH
    IF @@TRANCOUNT > 0
        ROLLBACK TRANSACTION;
    SET @Outputmessage = JSON_MODIFY(@Outputmessage, '$.result[0].error', '1');
    SET @Outputmessage = JSON_MODIFY(@Outputmessage, '$.result[0].msg', ERROR_MESSAGE());
    SELECT
        JSON_VALUE(value,'$.value') AS value,
        JSON_VALUE(value,'$.msg')   AS msg,
        JSON_VALUE(value,'$.error') AS error
    FROM OPENJSON(@Outputmessage,'$.result');
END CATCH

GO", "sp_one": "CREATE OR ALTER PROC [dbo].[sp_leadCaptures_one] (@pjsonfile VARCHAR(MAX))
AS
BEGIN
    SET NOCOUNT ON;
    DECLARE @leadCaptureId INT;
    SET @leadCaptureId = CAST(
        (SELECT TOP 1 JSON_VALUE(value, '$.leadCaptureId')
         FROM OPENJSON(@pjsonfile, '$.leadCaptures')) AS INT
    );
    SELECT
        leadCaptureId,
        ISNULL(companyId, 0) AS companyId,
        ISNULL(fullName, '') AS fullName,
        ISNULL(email, '') AS email,
        ISNULL(companyName, '') AS companyName,
        ISNULL(phone, '') AS phone,
        ISNULL(jobTitle, '') AS jobTitle,
        ISNULL(message, '') AS message,
        ISNULL(leadSource, '') AS leadSource,
        ISNULL(interestArea, '') AS interestArea,
        ISNULL(status, '') AS status,
        ISNULL(assignedTo, 0) AS assignedTo,
        ISNULL(privacyConsentAccepted, 0) AS privacyConsentAccepted,
        created_At,
        ISNULL(CONVERT(VARCHAR(30), updated_at, 126), '') AS updated_at
    FROM dbo.leadCaptures
    WHERE leadCaptureId = @leadCaptureId
    FOR JSON AUTO, ROOT('leadCaptures');
END
